name: Composite Horn Bowcrafters
description: Master the craft of laminated horn and sinew bows capable of piercing armor across immense ranges.
creativePrompt: How are the bows seasoned and glued with fish bladder glue? What archer tournaments decide war chiefs?
exampleNarrative: Drawing back recurved bows of horn and sinew, their archers darkened the sky with arrows that split shields at two hundred paces.

name: Primeval Beast Trackers
description: Read broken twigs, trampled moss, and scent trails to pursue quarry across untamed wilderness.
creativePrompt: What legendary beast did the greatest tracker hunt to its hidden lair?
exampleNarrative: From bent grass and disturbed dew, the trackers read the movements of entire herds as clearly as ink on parchment.

name: High-Altitude Ridge Climbers
description: Scale sheer icy precipices and needle crags with braided rawhide ropes and bronze crampons.
creativePrompt: How do the mountaineers bypass enemy valley blockades by marching over impossible glaciated passes?
exampleNarrative: Surefooted as mountain goats, scouting companies navigated ice chimneys and knife-edge cols where enemies dared not follow.

name: Wayfinder Navigators & Shipwrights
description: Navigate open seas using ocean swells, star constellations, and bird migration flights.
creativePrompt: What star stick charts do navigators weave from reeds and cowrie shells?
exampleNarrative: Guided by the rising of the Seven Sisters, their outrigger longships crossed open ocean without sight of land for forty days.

name: Crucible Pattern-Welded Smithing
description: Fold high-carbon iron with soft steel to create pattern-welded blades that flex without snapping.
creativePrompt: What sacred runes or makers marks are acid-etched into the flowing water-patterns of the steel?
exampleNarrative: Hammering glowing billets through ninety folds, the smiths forged swords with rippling damask surfaces that sliced clean through armor.

name: Cyclopean Drystone Masons
description: Fit multi-ton polygonal granite boulders together so precisely that a knife blade cannot slip between them.
creativePrompt: How do masons move fifty-ton megaliths without draft beasts? What architectural secrets endure earthquakes?
exampleNarrative: Without a grain of mortar, the masons locked fifty-ton granite blocks in interlocking geometry that laughed at earthquakes.

name: Forest Herbalists & Antidote Brewers
description: Identify curative roots, hemlock venoms, and healing poultices that halt wound gangrene and fevers.
creativePrompt: Which rare mountain flower is the only cure for cave-spider venom? Who keeps the secret herbals?
exampleNarrative: With salves of willow bark and spider-silk stitching, the healers pulled dying warriors back from the threshold of the underworld.

name: Runic Shaping & Elemental Singing
description: Sing ancient tonal resonant frequencies that coax raw granite to soften and spring water to freeze instantly.
creativePrompt: Which primordial song hums in harmony with the heartbeat of the world?
exampleNarrative: As the singer raised their voice, stone flowed like warm wax, carving arches and terraces to the rhythm of the melody.
